rules.title: Prepare for arrival
rules.description: Review practical steps for settling in Sweden before or soon after arrival.
rules.explanation: The respondent does not yet live in Sweden.

rules.title: Review residence guidance for your situation
rules.description: Review Swedish Migration Agency guidance for your nationality category ({origin}), purpose ({purpose}), and individual circumstances. These answers do not determine whether you need a permit or have a right of residence.
rules.explanation: The respondent has no current residence permit; origin and purpose may help find relevant guidance but are not enough to determine individual residence rights.

rules.title: Check eligibility and prepare a Personnummer application
rules.description: Review Skatteverket's current requirements for your situation and prepare the supporting documents before applying.
rules.explanation: The respondent lives in Sweden, has no Personnummer, and has not applied.

rules.title: Check your Personnummer application status
rules.description: You have submitted an application. Check its current status with Skatteverket, and do not submit a duplicate application.
rules.explanation: The respondent answered Yes to having submitted an application but did not select Waiting for decision; do not assume a decision is pending.

rules.title: Follow up on your pending Personnummer application
rules.description: You report that a decision is pending. Contact Skatteverket if you need an update, and do not submit a duplicate application.
rules.explanation: The respondent selected Waiting for decision, so the application is reported as pending.

rules.title: Check Swedish ID card eligibility and application steps
rules.description: Skatteverket's current guidance lists population registration, a Swedish personal identity number, and proof of identity among the requirements. Confirm current eligibility and other requirements for your circumstances before applying.
rules.explanation: A missing Swedish ID card calls for eligibility and application guidance, not an assumed legal obligation.

variants.title: Check Swedish ID card eligibility
variants.description: Ask Skatteverket how population registration, personal-number status, and identity documents apply to your circumstances before preparing an application.

rules.title: Prepare to open a bank account
rules.description: Compare banks' current identity, documentation, and appointment requirements. A Personnummer or Swedish ID card does not guarantee eligibility.
rules.explanation: The respondent does not have a Swedish bank account; requirements vary between banks.

rules.title: Check BankID eligibility and setup options
rules.description: BankID requires a Swedish personal identity number and is issued through banks. Ask your bank about its current checks and options; having a bank account alone does not guarantee eligibility.
rules.explanation: The respondent reports not having BankID. Current BankID guidance says a Swedish personal identity number is required; the issuing bank must confirm its checks and availability for this situation.

rules.title: Check your Försäkringskassan registration
rules.description: Confirm your registration status with Försäkringskassan and ask what applies to your circumstances. This answer tracks registration only; it does not establish insurance coverage or benefit eligibility.
rules.explanation: The respondent reports not being registered with Försäkringskassan. Coverage and benefit eligibility are determined separately for the person’s circumstances.

rules.title: Find housing and review rental terms
rules.description: Compare housing options and understand the rental contract, deposit, and notice terms before signing.
rules.explanation: The respondent is still looking for housing.

rules.title: Plan your next housing step
rules.description: Review your current arrangement and decide whether you need longer-term accommodation.
rules.explanation: The respondent has temporary housing, so a follow-up plan may be useful.

rules.title: Get a Public Transport Card
rules.description: Optional: check whether a regional travel card is useful for the area where you live or travel. You can do this independently of other roadmap steps.
rules.explanation: A regional travel card may be useful depending on the respondent’s location and travel habits; it is optional and independent of other roadmap steps.

rules.title: Check rules for your EU licence
rules.description: Confirm the rules and conditions for your particular licence and issuing country with Transportstyrelsen.
rules.explanation: The respondent plans to drive and selected the EU licence category; the issuing country and individual rules still need confirmation.

rules.title: Check rules for your driving licence
rules.description: Ask Transportstyrelsen whether your particular licence can be used or exchanged in Sweden; rules vary by issuing country and circumstances.
rules.explanation: The respondent plans to drive and selected Other; no exchange or eligibility outcome is assumed.

rules.title: Check your Swedish driving licence details
rules.description: Keep your licence accessible and check that its details are current.
rules.explanation: The respondent plans to drive and reports having a Swedish licence.

rules.title: Review job-seeking support
rules.description: Review Arbetsförmedlingen's services and create a profile if appropriate for your situation.
rules.explanation: The respondent's stated purpose is looking for work.

rules.title: Review study and student support steps
rules.description: Confirm enrolment requirements and any support available through your education provider.
rules.explanation: The respondent's stated purpose is study.

rules.title: Review work and employment onboarding
rules.description: Confirm your employment documents, workplace onboarding, and practical arrangements with your employer.
rules.explanation: The respondent's stated purpose is work.

rules.title: Review family settlement needs
rules.description: Check which practical registration, childcare, school, or family-support steps apply to your household.
rules.explanation: The respondent's stated purpose is family.
